gbm_population_evidence.quote: Must be suitable for treatment with TMZ and have IDH1/2-mutant glioma.
Participants with IDH 1/2-mutant glioma who are PARPi naive will receive AZD9574 and TMZ at escalating cohorts.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will assess the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), pharmacodynamics (PD), and preliminary efficacy of AZD9574 individually and in combination with anti-cancer agents in participants with advanced cancer that has recurred/progressed.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Progressive cancer at the time of enrollment.
Should have progressive disease after prior radiation therapy and one prior line of alkylating chemotherapy for their disease.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Maximum plasma concentration (Cmax): The Cmax of AZD9574 following a single dose and at steady state after multiple dosing, when given orally as monotherapy and in combination with anti-cancer agents will be evaluated.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The PD biomarker modulations of pH2AX (Ser139) at baseline and during treatment or pre-treatment will be assessed in tumour tissue when given orally as monotherapy.
Occupancy (%) is defined as the estimated difference in radioligand binding to PARP1 from baseline to positron emission tomography (PET) examination after drug administration.

role_evidence.quote: Participants with advanced/relapsed ovarian, breast, pancreatic, or prostate cancer who are deemed suitable for a PARPi will receive AZD9574 monotherapy at escalating cohorts.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named anywhere in the record; the only glioma cohorts (Module 2 Part A, Module 3 Panel 2) require IDH1/2-mutant glioma, so not_glioblastoma. Multi-tumour modular trial coded basket true as a design descriptor, although GBM is not eligible. Regimen coded combination because several modules combine AZD9574 with TMZ, T-DXd or Dato-DXd; Modules 1 and 3 Panels 1/3 are AZD9574 monotherapy. T-DXd and Dato-DXd coded soc_backbone as approved partner agents to which AZD9574 is added; arguably investigational partners (experimental_combination). IDH-mutant enrichment not coded as candidate-matched because the record states no link between PARP inhibition and IDH mutation. HER2-low/ultralow and HR-positive breast cancer requirements in Module 4 Part B not separately listed beyond the HER2 row.
